items.title: Salesforce (CRM) CEO Marc Benioff To Open 2026 AI Unleashed Summit
items.summary: Salesforce (NYSE:CRM) CEO Marc Benioff is set to deliver the opening keynote at the 2026 Six Five Summit: AI Unleashed, focusing on enterprise AI. The keynote will highlight Salesforce's role in the broader AI ecosystem and its approach to AI for large businesses. The appearance gives investors and industry watchers a fresh window into Salesforce's AI priorities and longer term product direction. This public platform is separate from recent leadership changes or government contract activity...
